intent: Display a block of source code — optionally across multiple named files/tabs — with copy-to-clipboard and syntax formatting.
avoid_when: the text isn't code (use a plain text block)
a11y_contract: the code region is `role="region"` with a default aria-label of "Code snippet" (override it when several snippets appear on one page); the line-number gutter is aria-hidden; the copy button ships its own aria-label ("Copy")
requires_data: the code string, or, for the tabbed variant, a list of {label, code} items
